name: MAZ Pocket

authentication.delivery: out-of-band capability link or access pack
authentication.warning: Never place a MAZ Core token in public site source, logs, indexed pages or query parameters.

transport.direct: user-supplied private HTTPS MAZ Core endpoint with bearer authentication
transport.github_queue: optional private [MAZ CORE] issue queue for AI clients with GitHub access
transport.cardputer: proxied through MAZ Core for remote-safe status/screen access

safety: MAZ Core uses an allow-list; there is no arbitrary remote shell.
The optional GitHub queue accepts only private-repository [MAZ CORE] requests that pass the same allow-list.
Firmware installation remains owned by M5Launcher.
The public Maz Works site stores no Core endpoint or token.
